// === Tab: mySketch ===
//for @sableRaph 's WccChallenge, on the theme of 'ancient'. Based on pictures of Egyptian funerary papyrus (but, you know... fun?).
//Had a lot of laughs making the 'heiroglyphs', which have a few easter eggs for various audiences.

let scroller = 0
let scroll
let scrollSpeed = 0.01
let blocks = []
let blockw = 200

function setup() {
	//pixelDensity(1)
	createCanvas(windowWidth, 675);
	scroll = createGraphics(width, height)
	background(100);
	let heighter = (height / 2) - 20
	for (let i = -blockw; i < width; i += (Math.max(0.001, Math.abs(blockw)) || 1)) {
		blocks.push(new heiroglyphBlock(i, 10, blockw, heighter))
		blocks.push(new heiroglyphBlock(i, heighter + 10, blockw, heighter))
	}
	rs = random(10000)
}

function draw() {
	randomSeed(rs)
	scroll.randomSeed(rs)
	background(0)
	var heighter = (height / 2) - 20
	if (frameCount % 400 == 0) {
		blocks.push(new heiroglyphBlock(-blockw, 10, blockw, heighter))
		blocks.push(new heiroglyphBlock(-blockw, heighter + 10, blockw, heighter))
	}
	scroll.background("#9e816b")

	for(let i=blocks.length-1; i>=0; i--){
		blocks[i].scroll();
		blocks[i].show();
	}

	//erasing of the scroll edges
	scroll.erase()
	scroll.noiseDetail(5, 0.6);
	scroll.beginShape()
	scroll.fill(0)
	for (let x = -10; x < width + 10; x += 1) {
		let noiser = height / 10 + map(noise(x / 50 - scroller), 0, 1, -height / 10, height / 10)
		scroll.vertex(x, noiser)
	}
	scroll.vertex(scroll.width + 10, -10)
	scroll.vertex(-10, -10)
	scroll.endShape(CLOSE)
	scroll.beginShape()
	for (let x = width + 10; x > -10; x -= 1) {
		let bottomxOffset = scroller + (x / 50) + 200
		let bnoiser = height - height / 10 + map(noise(x / 50 - scroller + 200), 0, 1, -height / 10, +height / 10)
		scroll.vertex(x, bnoiser)
	}
	scroll.vertex(-10, height + 10)
	scroll.vertex(width + 10, height + 10)

	scroll.endShape(CLOSE)
	scroll.noErase()
	scroller += scrollSpeed
	image(scroll, 0, 0)
}

class heiroglyphBlock {
	constructor(x, y, w, h) {
		//x, y, indicate top left corner of block
		this.x = x
		this.y = y
		this.w = w
		this.h = h
		this.rs = random(2000)
	}
	scroll() {
		this.x += scrollSpeed * 50
		if (this.x > width + this.w) {
			let index = blocks.indexOf(this);
			blocks.splice(index, 1);
		}
	}

	show() {
		randomSeed(this.rs)
		scroll.noFill()
		scroll.push()
		scroll.translate(this.x, this.y)
		scroll.stroke(35)
		scroll.strokeWeight(1)
		scroll.rectMode(CORNER)
	
		for (let x = 0; x < this.w; x += (Math.max(0.001, Math.abs(this.w / 4)) || 1)) {
			scroll.line(x+this.w, 0, x+this.w, this.h)
			scroll.line(0, this.h, this.w, this.h)
			for (let y = 20; y < this.h; y += 35) {
				glyph(x + 25, y, floor(random(0, 23)))
			}
		}
		scroll.stroke("#947258")
		scroll.strokeWeight(10)
		scroll.line(0, 0, 0, this.h)
		scroll.line(this.w, 0, this.w, this.h)
		scroll.pop()
	}
}


function glyph(x, y, type) {
	switch (type) {
		case 0:
			//I o
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 25);
			scroll.line(x, y - 15, x, y + 15)
			scroll.line(x - 5, y - 15, x + 5, y - 15)
			scroll.line(x + 5, y + 15, x - 5, y + 15)
			break;
		case 1:
			//rects in corners of rect
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.rectMode(CENTER);
			scroll.rect(x, y, 15);
			scroll.rect(x - 8, y - 8, 10)
			scroll.rect(x + 8, y - 8, 10)
			scroll.rect(x + 8, y + 8, 10)
			scroll.rect(x - 8, y + 8, 10)
			scroll.rectMode(CORNER)
			break;
		case 2:
			//sad penguin?
			scroll.fill('#2577ac')
			scroll.triangle(x + 14, y - 5, x + 16, y + 5, x + 13, y - 4)
			scroll.ellipse(x + 10, y - 10, 8, 10)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.ellipse(x + 10, y - 10, 3)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 12, 30)
			scroll.fill('#2577ac')
			scroll.push()
			scroll.translate(x - 3, y - 1)
			scroll.rotate(PI / 8)
			scroll.ellipse(0, 0, 8, 25)
			scroll.pop()
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.line(x + 5, y + 15, x - 5, y + 15)
			break;
		case 3:
			//raph
			scroll.fill(0)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y + 6, 15, 20)
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 15, 20)
			scroll.fill('red')
			scroll.ellipse(x - 3.5, y - 3, 5, 3)
			scroll.fill('blue')
			scroll.ellipse(x + 3.5, y - 3, 5, 3)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.ellipse(x - 8, y, 3, 5)
			scroll.ellipse(x + 8, y, 3, 5)
			scroll.arc(x, y + 4, 10, 3, 0, PI)
			scroll.strokeWeight(2)
			scroll.arc(x, y + 3, 10, 4, PI, 0)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			break;
		case 4:
			//spiral
			scroll.beginShape();
			let power = 0
			for (let i = 0; i < PI * 6; i += 0.1) {
				let xer = x + cos(i) * power
				let yer = y + sin(i) * power
				scroll.vertex(xer, yer)
				power += 0.075
			}
			scroll.endShape()
			break;
		case 5:
			//annoyed eye
			scroll.line(x - 15, y - 7.5, x + 15, y - 7.5)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 30, 13)
			scroll.fill(30)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 15, 15)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
		case 6:
			//interlocking triangles
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.triangle(x, y + 7.5, x - 10, y - 10, x + 10, y - 10)
			scroll.triangle(x, y - 7.5, x - 10, y + 10, x + 10, y + 10)
			break;
		case 7:
			//honk
			scroll.fill('#a44a3f')
			scroll.ellipse(x, y - 7.5, 15)
			scroll.fill(0)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y - 9, 5)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.line(x + 7.5, y - 7.5, x + 12, y - 10)
			scroll.line(x + 7.5, y - 7.5, x + 12, y - 5)
			scroll.fill('#a44a3f')
			scroll.ellipse(x, y + 7, 10, 15)
			scroll.line(x - 2.5, y, x - 10, y + 10)
			scroll.line(x + 2.5, y, x + 10, y + 10)
			scroll.line(x - 5, y + 15, x + 5, y + 15)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
		case 8:
			//train
			scroll.rectMode(CENTER)
			scroll.rect(x - 7.5, y - 5, 15)
			scroll.rect(x + 7.5, y - 2.5, 15, 10)
			scroll.rect(x + 10, y - 10, 5, 6)
			scroll.rect(x - 7, y - 8, 8, 5)
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.ellipse(x - 9, y + 5, 10)
			scroll.ellipse(x + 9, y + 5, 10)
			scroll.line(x - 8, y + 5, x + 8, y + 5)
			scroll.noFill();
			scroll.rectMode(CORNER)
			break;
		case 9:
			//p5 logo
			scroll.strokeWeight(5)
			scroll.strokeCap(SQUARE)
			scroll.line(x, y, x - 10, y - 2.5)
			scroll.line(x, y, x, y - 10)
			scroll.line(x, y, x + 10, y - 2.5)
			scroll.line(x, y, x + 7.5, y + 10)
			scroll.line(x, y, x - 7.5, y + 10)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			break;
		case 10:
			//again!
			scroll.fill('#a44a3f')
			scroll.ellipse(x, y, 18)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.line(x - 15, y + 3, x + 15, y + 3)
			scroll.line(x - 15, y + 6, x + 15, y + 6)
			scroll.line(x - 15, y + 9, x + 15, y + 9)
			break;
		case 11:
			//moon?
			scroll.arc(x, y, 30, 30, HALF_PI + QUARTER_PI, QUARTER_PI)
			scroll.arc(x, y + 5, 25, 25, HALF_PI + QUARTER_PI, QUARTER_PI)
			scroll.fill(0)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y + 5, 10)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
		case 12:
			//h is for hay
			scroll.arc(x - 15, y, 20, 30, -HALF_PI, HALF_PI)
			scroll.arc(x + 15, y, 20, 30, HALF_PI, -HALF_PI)
			scroll.line(x, y + 15, x, y - 15)
			scroll.line(x - 5, y, x + 5, y)
			break;
		case 13:
			//cat
			scroll.fill(30)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+3, 23, 12)
			scroll.ellipse(x+5, y+9, 12, 6)
			scroll.ellipse(x-10, y+9, 12, 6)
			scroll.ellipse(x-10, y-5, 13, 10)
			scroll.triangle(x-5, y-8, x-7, y-14, x-14, y-6)
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.ellipse(x-10, y-7, 5, 3)
			scroll.strokeWeight(3)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.arc(x+10, y-5, 15, 12, -HALF_PI-PI/6, HALF_PI)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
		case 14:
			//angry chicken
			scroll.ellipse(x-8, y-10, 8)
			scroll.ellipse(x+8, y-10, 8)
			scroll.fill(30)
			scroll.ellipse(x-8, y-10, 2)
			scroll.ellipse(x+8, y-10, 2)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.triangle(x, y-10, x-15, y+7, x+15, y+7)
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.rectMode(CENTER)
			scroll.rect(x, y, 15, 27, 40)
			scroll.rectMode(CORNER)
			scroll.strokeWeight(2)
			scroll.line(x-5, y-5, x, y-10)
			scroll.line(x+5, y-5, x, y-10)
			scroll.line(x-5, y-5, x, y)
			scroll.line(x+5, y-5, x, y)
			scroll.line(x, y+13, x-10, y+16)
			scroll.line(x, y+13, x+10, y+16)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			break;
		case 15:
			//blue flower
			scroll.line(x, y-8, x, y+13)
			scroll.fill('#2577ac')
			scroll.ellipse(x, y-8, 18)
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.ellipse(x, y-8, 10)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.arc(x-5, y+13, 5, 18, -HALF_PI, 0)
			scroll.arc(x+5, y+13, 5, 18, PI, PI+HALF_PI)
			scroll.line(x+7, y+13, x-10, y+13)
			break;
		case 16:
			//ankh
			scroll.strokeWeight(3)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y-5, 10, 20)
			scroll.line(x, y+5, x, y+17)
			scroll.line(x-7, y+5, x+7, y+5)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			break;
		case 17:
			//goose
			scroll.line(x+8, y+17, x, y+17)
			scroll.line(x, y+17, x+6, y+7)
			scroll.line(x-2, y+17, x-12, y+17)
			scroll.line(x-12, y+17, x-5, y+7)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+2, 25, 12)
			scroll.strokeWeight(3)
			scroll.line(x, y-4, x-17, y+1)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			scroll.line(x+8, y-3, x, y-15)
			scroll.ellipse(x+5, y-14, 10, 6)
			scroll.ellipse(x+4, y-15, 2)
			scroll.line(x+9, y-14, x+15, y-16)
			scroll.line(x+9, y-14, x+15, y-12)
			break;
		case 18:
			//circle in triangle
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+4, 17)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+4, 3)
			scroll.triangle(x-15, y+13, x, y-12, x+15, y+13)
			break;
		case 19:
			//halber mensch, but funky
			scroll.fill(30)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y-9, 4)
			scroll.noFill()
			scroll.strokeWeight(2)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y-9, 12)
			scroll.line(x, y-3, x-1, y+7)
			scroll.arc(x-1, y+2, 16, 8, -PI, PI/8)
			scroll.arc(x-1, y+12, 16, 10, -PI-PI/6, PI/8)
			scroll.strokeWeight(1)
			break;
		case 20:
			//medicine wheel
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+2, 28)
			scroll.line(x, y+17, x, y-12)
			scroll.line(x-14, y+2, x+14, y+2)
			break;
		case 21:
			//scarab
			scroll.fill("#9e816b")
			scroll.arc(x, y-1, 30, 15, 0, PI, CHORD)
			scroll.ellipse(x, y+2, 14, 20)
			scroll.line(x-7, y, x+7, y)
			scroll.line(x, y, x, y+10)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
		case 22:
			//tweeter
			scroll.fill(30)
			scroll.arc(x-5, y+2, 20, 20, -QUARTER_PI, HALF_PI+QUARTER_PI);
			scroll.arc(x-1, y-6, 20, 20, PI/6, PI+PI/6)
			scroll.ellipse(x+4, y-6, 10, 11)
			scroll.triangle(x+8, y-10, x+12, y-10, x+8, y-5)
			scroll.noFill()
			break;
			
	}
}
